title: On a problem of Johnson and Wolfe
summary: In 1979, Johnson and Wolfe proved that norm-attaining operators are dense in $L(C(K),C(S))$ when $K$ and $S$ are compact Hausdorff spaces in the real setting. The corresponding complex case has remained open since then, mainly because the real proof relies on order and sign-decomposition arguments that are no longer available for complex measures. In this paper, we settle the complex case.
